summary: Examples of ternary to set volume modes, choose a VPC subnet ID, and pick the service module based on ansible_service_mgr.
questions: How do I choose between systemd and service modules based on the service manager?
How do I pick a public or private subnet ID with ternary?
What are some examples of the ternary filter?

answer_card.title: ternary examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
volume_mode: "{{ (item|int < 11) | ternary('rw', 'dp') }}"

vpc_subnet_id: "{{ (ec2_subnet_type == 'public') | ternary(ec2_vpc_public_subnet_id, ec2_vpc_private_subnet_id) }}"

- name: use systemd unless upstart is present
  service:
    state: restarted
    enabled: yes
    use: "{{ (ansible_service_mgr == 'upstart') | ternary('service', 'systemd') }}"
```
